Removing

- Check that the extension and contraction pipe for the hood front lock hydraulic actuator is not damaged.

- Position the extension and contraction pipe for the hood front lock hydraulic actuator.

Remove the plugs from the connectors and clean the connectors; check that the seals are effective.

- Engage the hydraulic actuator onto the ball joints and fit the retaining clips.

When fitting the bands, position the wiring and the pipes as close as possible to one another to prevent interference with moving parts.
